name: Blackfathom Deeps: the Fathom Stone lights up and pays out the Fathom Core for Amongst the Ruins (#14041)
contract: Amongst the Ruins (6921, Horde, from Je'neu Sancrea 12736 in Zoram'gar) wants one Fathom Core 16762. The core
drops only from the Fathom Stone 177964 (chest, lock 93, loot 15100 -> 16762 at 100% quest-required, interaction
condition flag 4), whose one spawn is guid 32686 at -782.0, -63.6, -45.1 in the water by the Moonshrine Ruins,
spawnMask 7. #14041 reports the core cannot be obtained. Expected: for a player with 6921 in the log the world
stone is a usable quest object, while a player without the quest sees it inactive, and the stone's loot hands
over 16762. The loot actions only open a gameobject the player summoned, so a copy beside the world spawn
proves the loot path while the quest-active reads prove the world spawn. prepare_quest grants the required core,
so the scenario destroys it first to put 6921 back in progress.
